item.title: Are We Still Practising Family Medicine? — Concerned Specialist
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

The concern is whether “strengthening the clinical role” eventually becomes “clinical work is the main role”, as other core functions of Family Medicine are slowly pushed aside.
